title: Sales Rep selector offers only reps whose sales-rep toggle is on
refs: SV-8636 (specs/sbr-sales-by-representative.md Story 19 S19-R2; S19-R8 — toggle entry path Settings - Staff - edit the staff member per PRD companion video 2026-07-30 [newest-wins] 09:17-09:41; exact toggle label to confirm live)
custom_preconds: 1. At least one staff member has the sales-rep toggle ON and at least one has it OFF. To arrange this: open Settings, go to Staff, edit the staff member, and use the sales-rep toggle there (restore both afterward).
custom_steps:
1. Open a Work Order and open the "Sales Rep" selector.
2. Search the option list for both staff members.
3. Inspect the selector's accessible name.
custom_expected:
1. The toggle-ON staff member is offered as a selectable rep.
2. The toggle-OFF staff member is NOT offered as a new selection.
3. The selector carries the accessible name "Sales Rep".
